description: WP-G4 Codex: Orks (11e) RAUCOUS OCCUPANTS (Big'ed Bossbunka): while the Bossbunka is within range of its controller's home objective, add the OC of models embarked within it to its OC (printed 0). Fixture ork11e_g4_oc (P1 Orks' Command phase; the Bossbunka on obj_home_1 with 10 Boyz embarked; 3 Custodian Guard (OC 2 each) contesting). Objective control is recomputed through MissionManager (the scoring path the board's objective markers render); P1 controls its home objective; with the occupants battle-shocked the Guard take it back. Setup privilege: the battle-shocked flag in the A/B step.

steps.comment: the Boyz are embarked in the Bossbunka (printed OC 0) on P1's home objective
RAUCOUS OCCUPANTS: the Bossbunka adds the embarked Boyz' OC and P1 controls its home objective against the Custodian Guard
the Bossbunka's OC = 10 Boyz x OC 2
the Command panel's OBJECTIVE CONTROL readout shows HOME_1: Orks
A/B: battle-shocked occupants add nothing — the Custodian Guard control it
